TUT_CARD: Click a squad member (or press Tab). Lit tiles show where it can move.
Each unit gets 3 AP a turn. Each AP is one full move. Pistols and sabers cost 1 AP to attack, rifles 2. Shooting does not end your turn.
Shield icons mark cover: solid = full, outline = half. End moves next to it. Hit enemies from the side to flank.
Pick an ability, click a target to see the hit %, then Confirm. Space aims at the best target; Space again fires.
Jedi spend Focus on powers; Meditate refills it. Choke works but adds Darkness.
A downed ally bleeds out in a few turns. Stand next to them and Stabilize, or use a medkit.
Press End turn. Click any enemy to see its plan. Codex (C) explains everything; ? lists all keys.
